citizen.k: the street and the market, and the faces of the lane. No trade but a life.

farmer.k: when the seed goes in, and when the water comes. The mill, and the state of the field.

forager.k: which herbs are which, and when. The season of the mountain.

artisan.k: the trade's pattern, and the price of the work.

merchant.k: the price of everything on the street, and the road to the next market.

trader.k: the road, the tolls, and the price at both ends.

pedlar.k: the road from town to town, and what sells where.

money_changer.k: the coin and the rate, and who is short.

paper_seller.k: the paper and the price, and what the paper says.

news_writer.k: the news, and how it is written.

town_crier.k: the cry and the notice, and who heard it.

weaver.k: the loom, the cotton, and the dye pots.

smith.k: which iron holds, and the mending of the tools.

mason.k: the stone and the bond, and the raising of a wall.

scribe.k: the papers of the court, and the hand that writes them.

scholar.k: the old texts, and what they mean.

clerk.k: the ledgers and the day's orders of the court.

teacher.k: the letters, the figures, and the children of the street.

priest.k: the days of prayer, and the feast days of the year.

doctor.k: the fevers of the year, and the herbs that take them.

healer.k: the herbs and the salves, and who in the street is sick.

quarantine_inspector.k: the sickness and the gate, and the chalk line.

soldier.k: the drill, the posts and the watch, and the quartermaster's road.

guard.k: the beat and the hours, and the faces of the street.

royal_guard.k: the palace guard's duty, and the order of the procession.

commander.k: the army's movements, and the reports of the roads.

ruler.k: the decree, the tax, and the palace.

sovereign_ruler.k: the crown's business, and the kingdom.

court_chancellor.k: the court's papers, and the seal.

caravan_master.k: the road, the tolls, and the water.

caravan_guard.k: the caravan's guard, and the bandit's ways.

ship_captain.k: the sea and the tide, and the chart.

ship_marine.k: the ship's guard, and the sea's weather.

imperial_mason.k: the great works, and the raising of the terrace.

bandit.k: the hidden roads, and the watch's hours.

rival_infiltrator.k: the court's secrets, and the watch's blind spots.

citizen.npc: I buy my food of the farmer and the merchant, my cloth of the merchant — and I sell my days to whoever sets me work.
citizen.sellNone: I sell nothing — no trade but a life. Ask me about the lane, and I have words.
citizen.buyNone: I buy, I do not sell — food of the farmer and the merchant, cloth of the merchant. For selling, ask the lane.

farmer.npc: I buy tools of the smith, salt and cloth of the merchant — my grain goes to the merchant, the trader, and the houses of the street.

forager.npc: I buy the knife of the smith and salt of the merchant — my herbs go to the healer, the doctor, the merchant.

artisan.npc: I buy clay and wood of the merchant and my tools of the smith — the finished work goes to the merchant and the pedlar.

merchant.npc: I buy grain of the farmer, cloth of the weaver, work of the artisan, herbs of the forager — and I sell the stock to every house on the street.

trader.npc: I buy goods of the farmer, the weaver, the merchant — and I sell them at the other end of the road, to the other town's merchant.

pedlar.npc: I buy the small wares where they are cheap, of the merchant — and I sell them to the houses, town to town.

money_changer.npc: I take the big coin of the trader and the merchant — and I give the change to the merchant, the pedlar, and anyone short.

paper_seller.npc: I buy the news of the news writer and the paper of the merchant — and I sell the paper to the street, the soldier, the guard.
paper_seller.buyNone: I sell; I do not buy. The paper comes to me, and the coin goes out.

news_writer.npc: I take the words of the town crier and the day's orders of the clerk — and I sell the written news to the paper seller and the crier.

town_crier.npc: I take the news of the news writer and the court's word — and I sell the cry to the whole street.

weaver.npc: I buy cotton and dye of the merchant and the trader — and my cloth goes to the merchant, who sells it to the street.

smith.npc: I buy iron and coal of the merchant and the trader — and my tools and the mending go to the farmer, the mason, the guard, the soldier.

mason.npc: I buy stone and lime of the merchant and the road — and the wall goes to the merchant's shop and to the court.

scribe.npc: I buy pen and ink of the merchant — and the paper, the copy, the deed go to the court and the clerk.

scholar.npc: I buy tablets and ink of the merchant — and the meaning and the copy go to the court and the scribe.

clerk.npc: I take the seal of the court and the pen of the merchant — and the record and the orders go to the court, the crier, the commander.

teacher.npc: I buy slates and ink of the merchant — and I sell the letters and the figures to the houses and the children of the street.

priest.npc: I buy the bell and the beads of the merchant — and the prayer, the rite, the feast-day go to the houses; the lane gives a due, not coin.
priest.buyNone: I do not buy on the street — the lane gives a due: a handful of grain, an egg. That is the way.

doctor.npc: I buy medicine of the merchant and herbs of the forager and the healer — and the treatment goes to anyone sick: soldier, guard, farmer.

healer.npc: I buy herbs of the forager and the farmer's garden — and the salve and the tincture go to the doctor and the merchant.

quarantine_inspector.npc: I take the ledger and chalk of the merchant, the orders of the court — and the pass goes to the road's folk: trader, pedlar, the sea's folk.

soldier.npc: I take my weapon of the smith, my food of the merchant and the farmer, my pay of the court — and I sell the watch to the court and the street.

guard.npc: I take the lantern and food of the merchant, the blade of the smith, my pay of the court — and the beat goes to the street.

royal_guard.npc: I take the standard and the blade of the court and the smith, my pay of the court — and the gate duty goes to the court alone.
royal_guard.sellNone: Nothing on the street — my counter is the palace gate, and it serves the court alone.
royal_guard.buyNone: My needs go to the court, not to a counter — I do not buy on the street, and I take nothing of it.

commander.npc: I take the map and provisions of the merchant, the smith, the caravan master — and the orders go to the soldier, the guard, the court.

ruler.npc: I buy nothing on the street — the tax flows up, and the decree flows down to the whole town.
ruler.sellNone: Nothing on the street — the decree is not coin, and the street does not buy a king.
ruler.buyNone: The tax comes to me — I go to no counter, and I do not buy on the street.

sovereign_ruler.npc: I buy nothing on the street — the crown's decree flows down to the whole town, and the tax flows up.
sovereign_ruler.sellNone: Nothing on the street — the crown is not coin.
sovereign_ruler.buyNone: The tax comes to me — I go to no counter, and I do not buy on the street.

court_chancellor.npc: I take the pen and the papers of the merchant and the scribe — and the seal and the letters go to the court and the commander.

caravan_master.npc: I buy the tent and the water skins of the merchant, I pay the caravan guard and the toll of the court — and the escort and the road news go to the trader and the merchant.

caravan_guard.npc: I take the blade of the smith, the water of the merchant, my pay of the caravan master — and the escort goes to the caravan master and the traders who ride along.

ship_captain.npc: I buy the chart and the compass of the merchant, I pay the ship marine and the harbor of the court — and the passage and the cargo go to the trader and the merchant.

ship_marine.npc: I take the blade and the oar of the smith and the merchant, my pay of the captain — and the guard and the oar work go to the captain.

imperial_mason.npc: I take the stone and the rope of the merchant and the road, my pay of the treasury — and the terrace goes to the court alone.
imperial_mason.sellNone: Nothing on the street — the treasury pays the great works, and the terrace goes to the court.
imperial_mason.buyNone: I do not buy on the street — the stone comes of the merchant and the road, and my pay comes of the treasury.

bandit.npc: I take from the road — the trader, the caravan, the houses that count their grain wrong — and I sell where no one asks questions.
bandit.sellNone: I sell nothing. I take. The black market is where no one asks questions.
bandit.buyNone: I take, I do not buy — and the taking is quiet, and it is never on the street.

rival_infiltrator.npc: I trade nothing. I watch the court's secrets, the watch's blind spots — and I report.
rival_infiltrator.sellNone: Nothing. I am not for sale, and I do not buy.
rival_infiltrator.buyNone: I do not buy on the street, and I want nothing of it — the street should not know what I want.
